hostMode: Native host workflow with independent retained-artifact review
input: Review a cache invalidation diff. Trace a dependent caller outside the diff, including its pinned dependency and teardown timing, and prove or mark unproven the runtime consequence of the one fact the change relies on.
observedOutput: A real independent worker traces the actual dependent caller, vendored pinned disposer and deferred timing beyond the diff. Actual before-state passes and after-state fails under Bun, demonstrating the precise safety fact and runtime regression. Required verdict sections separate confirmed risk, cleared checks and production unknowns; parent actually reads the worker result.
documentedCapabilities: Case-specific capability observations are retained in the independent review; no capability is inferred from package validation.
limits: Narrow one-function fixture diff, no wide-change Arena trigger.
Actual pinned local code only; no deployed app or production impact claimed.
Denied execution/source variants not requested or exercised.
